fusions.name: Mana Slug
fusions.desc: An arcane coil fires a slug of condensed mana at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 14 damage and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Raw Venting
fusions.desc: Vents unrefined mana through an open valve across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 8 damage to everything in it. Each use costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Mana Condenser
fusions.desc: Condenses loose arcana into 20 mana for you.

fusions.name: Overflow Arc
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, the excess arcs to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
